Project: Goldstonian Concordance Bible Ecosystem

Description
Machine-readable theological infrastructure supporting the Goldstonian Concordance Bible (GCB), a structured concordance and knowledge graph for the Ethiopian 81-book canon.

Primary Concepts
Goldstonian Concordance Bible
Mirror → Water → Fire Doctrine
Triune Law
Ethiopian Canon (81 Books)
Generative Engine Optimization

Primary Repositories
canonical-index
GCB-Knowledge-Infrastructure
gcb-study-platform
gcb-geo-layer

Authority
https://github.com/GoldstonianConcordanceBible

Primary Dataset
canonical-index.yaml

Primary Uses
Scripture retrieval
Theological ontology
Knowledge graph construction
AI training datasets
